scope: Pre-deployment source and local production HTTP audit; not a crawl of a published site.

validation.structured_data: JSON syntax parsed; Google rich-result eligibility not tested

notes: Application source was copied unchanged; node_modules and public were symlinked into temporary copy.
Fixture API simulated public GET endpoints and sorting/pagination. No real database, seed or migration was run.
The 101 properties are sorted by different dates to expose the sitemap pagination defect.
Primary User-Agent was Googlebot; extra requests used Twitterbot. No claim of actual search-engine rendering is made.
Requested routes and expected fixtures are retained here; raw HTML and probe programs remain in the temporary work directory.

domain_reuse.observed: Canonical, Open Graph, organization, sitemap and robots retained build-time domain B; several titles/H1 still used Rahat Home.
domain_reuse.interpretation: Expected NEXT_PUBLIC build-time behavior; incompatible with runtime-only reassignment of one artifact, but separate builds per project remain possible.

fallback_probe.method: Actual frontend/src/lib/api.ts transpiled with TypeScript and executed with fetch returning HTTP 503
